(deftype IntegerRangeChunk [start step count]
  ICounted
  (-count [coll] count)

  ISeq
  (-first [coll] start)

  IIndexed
  (-nth [coll i]
    (suss.bootstrap/unchecked-add start (suss.bootstrap/unchecked-multiply i step)))
  (-nth [coll i not-found]
    (if (and (>= i 0) (< i count))
      (suss.bootstrap/unchecked-add start (suss.bootstrap/unchecked-multiply i step))
      not-found))

  ;; JVM IChunk supplies reduction as well as indexed access. Suss represents
  ;; that operation with IReduce, as ArrayChunk does, for core's private fold.
  IReduce
  (-reduce [coll f] (ci-reduce coll f))
  (-reduce [coll f init] (ci-reduce coll f init))

  IChunk
  (-drop-first [coll]
    (if (<= count 1)
      (throw (suss.bootstrap/error "-drop-first of empty chunk"))
      (IntegerRangeChunk. (suss.bootstrap/unchecked-add start step) step (dec count)))))
rationale: Retain the complete pinned chunk implementation and adapt its out-of-range throw from JavaScript Error construction to the typed portable runtime error. Elements inside the chunk step with unchecked arithmetic, which never overflows within the range (#335). Expose chunk reduction through IReduce, as ArrayChunk does, so the private apply fold can perform Clojure 1.12.6 reduce1 chunk dispatch. The existing ci-reduce preserves indexed order and public reduced-result handling; numeric apply callbacks return numbers.
